prompts.question: Is the company listed on B3 - Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão as an issuer of shares or debt, and if so under which corporate governance tier (Novo Mercado, Nível 1, Nível 2)?
prompts.why_it_matters: An exchange listing shows the company meets B3 disclosure and governance rules, and its absence contradicts any claim of being publicly traded.
prompts.how_to_query: Open B3's listed companies search and enter the company's full corporate name or ticker.
prompts.found_when: The company or its securities appear in B3's listed company records with a governance tier.
prompts.not_found_when: A search by full corporate name and trade name returns no listed issuer.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The B3 search page cannot be loaded or the name is too common to isolate one issuer.

prompts.question: Is the company recorded by Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) as an authorised or supervised financial entity, and does it appear free of BCB administrative sanctions?
prompts.why_it_matters: Financial activity in Brazil requires BCB authorisation, and a BCB sanction is a direct regulatory red flag.
prompts.how_to_query: Search BCB's supervised entities data for the company's corporate name, then check the administrative sanctions records.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in BCB's supervised entities data or in its sanctions lists.
prompts.not_found_when: Neither the supervised entities data nor the sanctions records return the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The BCB dataset cannot be queried or the name returns many unrelated financial entities.

prompts.question: Does Casa dos Dados show the company with an active CNPJ whose registered name, address, capital and partners match what the company presents publicly?
prompts.why_it_matters: The CNPJ record confirms the company is legally registered and active, and mismatches point to impersonation or stale claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company's razão social or CNPJ in Casa dos Dados' company search and open the matching record.
prompts.found_when: A CNPJ record for the company appears and its registration status and details can be read.
prompts.not_found_when: A search on the full corporate name and CNPJ returns no registered company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable or the name returns too many similarly named companies to identify one.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on Consumidor.gov.br with a consumer complaint record, and what are its resolution rate and response time indicators?
prompts.why_it_matters: This official platform shows how the company actually handles consumer disputes, not just how it markets itself.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Consumidor.gov.br for the company by name and open its participant company page.
prompts.found_when: The company has a page showing complaint volumes, resolution index or response time.
prompts.not_found_when: The company search returns no registered participant company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company search cannot be reached or the name matches several similarly named registered companies.

prompts.question: Does the Imprensa Oficial do Estado de São Paulo (DOE SP) carry company publications such as shareholder notices, audited accounts, state contracts or state tax penalties involving the company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Official gazette entries are legally binding public notices and can reveal obligations, contracts or penalties the company does not advertise.

source.name: Imprensa Oficial do Estado de São Paulo (DOE SP)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the DOE SP advanced search, enter the company's razão social or trade name and scan the returned publications.
prompts.found_when: Gazette publications naming the company appear in the search results.
prompts.not_found_when: A search on the company name over a broad date range returns no publication.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The advanced search is unavailable, or the name is too generic to attribute any publication to the company.

prompts.question: Does Exame report on the company or include it in its 'Melhores e Maiores' corporate performance ranking?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent business press coverage and ranking inclusion are third-party evidence of the company's real scale and standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan Exame's 'Melhores e Maiores' ranking pages and its site search for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company is named in the ranking or in an Exame article about it.
prompts.not_found_when: Neither the ranking pages nor a site search return the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The ranking pages are not readable or only a search box is available and it fails.

prompts.question: Does the company operate an official store or seller account on Mercado Livre Brasil, and what reputation level, sales volume and customer reviews does it show?
prompts.why_it_matters: Marketplace reputation, delivery punctuality and dispute rates show how the company behaves as a seller to end customers.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Mercado Livre's official stores and sellers for the company or brand name and open the matching store page.
prompts.found_when: A store or seller profile for the company appears with reputation and review data.
prompts.not_found_when: No official store or seller account matches the company or brand name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The store search cannot be queried or the brand name is used by unrelated third-party resellers.

prompts.question: Do Pelando community threads discuss the company, and do users report trustworthy or problematic purchasing experiences with it?
prompts.why_it_matters: Community debate is candid, unsponsored feedback on whether the company delivers, honours prices and treats buyers well.
prompts.how_to_query: Use Pelando's search for the company or store name and read the deal threads and comments mentioning it.
prompts.found_when: Search results contain deals or threads where users discuss the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no deal or thread referencing the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page cannot be loaded or the company name yields only unrelated deals.

prompts.question: Is the company, or any of its executives, listed by the Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU) as inidôneo or with irregular accounts, barring participation in federal public contracts?
prompts.why_it_matters: A TCU debarment or irregular-accounts ruling legally prevents the company from contracting with the federal administration.

source.name: Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU) - Contas Irregulares e Inidôneos

prompts.how_to_query: Search the TCU inidôneos and contas irregulares certificate list by the company's corporate name and by its partners' names.
prompts.found_when: The company or one of its executives appears in the TCU inidôneos or irregular accounts list.
prompts.not_found_when: Searches on the corporate name and on the listed partners return no TCU ruling.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The TCU certificate list cannot be searched or the name is too common to match a unique entity.

prompts.question: Is the company covered on Promobit as a legitimate retailer, and do users report delivery, payment or trustworthiness problems with it?
prompts.why_it_matters: Community verification on Promobit separates real retailers from scam storefronts and surfaces recurring fulfilment failures.
prompts.how_to_query: Open Promobit's store pages for the company name and scan its coupon and offer lists plus user comments.
prompts.found_when: A Promobit store page or offer list exists for the company with user feedback.
prompts.not_found_when: No store page, offer list or user post on Promobit mentions the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The store listing cannot be browsed or the name matches several unrelated merchants.

prompts.question: Does the Tribunal de Justiça de São Paulo (TJSP) show civil lawsuits, debt executions, bankruptcy or judicial recovery (recuperação judicial) filings involving the company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Court filings reveal unpaid debts, insolvency risk and litigation history that the company may keep quiet about.

source.name: Tribunal de Justiça de São Paulo (TJSP) - Consulta Processual e Falências

prompts.how_to_query: Use TJSP's process search with the party-name option and enter the company's razão social.
prompts.found_when: Case records naming the company as a party or as the debtor in a recovery/bankruptcy filing are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A party-name search on the full corporate name returns no case.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The court search is unavailable, requires a captcha that cannot be passed, or the name is too common to match one company.
